:::{#def-held-out-set}
#### Held-out set

A **held-out set** for a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is a list of $m$ further observations,
none of them in $\trainset$,
that the [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) does not use
and on which the [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$ is scored:

$$
\paren{(x_{0,1}, y_{0,1}), \ldots, (x_{0,m}, y_{0,m})}.
$$ {#eq-held-out-set}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.1], who call it a hold-out set.
:::

:::
